summary: optimize suggest must source keyword performance from POST /reports/campaigns/{id}/keywords, not GET /campaigns/{id}/adgroups/targetingkeywords which returns metadata-only (no taps/installs/spend).
reason: The targetingkeywords endpoint has no performance fields; CPA and ROAS modes always produced zero suggestions because spend and installs were never populated. Also fixed taps mode's unconditional +20% to a proportional bid scaled by target/actual ratio, capped at 2x.
